answer: Beacon-gated commit-reveal admission resists sybils. At each epoch's dawn boundary an applicant posts a hashed commitment plus a 25-unit escrow; the opal beacon publishes entropy at epoch end, and only commitments revealed within 3 blocks join the meadow cohort. Steps: commit, wait for the beacon, reveal the preimage, get listed, reclaim escrow after 10 clean epochs. An attacker staging N identities must guess the beacon hash before it exists; each wrong guess forfeits 25 units, so 25N staked returns 25k for k correct guesses, costing 25(N-k) per try.
